messages:
sylvia: FYI rolling 550 driver to staging eu-west hit failures. DKMS rebuild failing on Ubuntu 20.04 + HWE kernels, 6 nodes boot-looped with kernel panic 'nvidia: module verification failed' / 'Failed to load nvidia.ko'. Logs below.

matt: saw similar in us-west on 525->535 mixed rollout, but only on nodes with 5.19/6.1 kernels.

deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-18T09:14: started rolling nvidia-driver:550 to eu-west-staging

chris: paste of /var/lib/dkms/nvidia/550/build/make.log:
```
DKMS make.log for nvidia-550 (kernel: 6.1.0-25-generic)
Error! Could not find module source directory.
make: *** [Makefile:xx: modules] Error 2
```

ana: possible Secure Boot signature rejection. Check 'mokutil --sb-state' and 'dmesg | grep -i nvidia' - we saw 'module verification failed: signature and/or required key missing'.

mike: if secure boot is on, DKMS will fail unless we sign the module. Options: 1) disable secure boot for canary VMs, 2) pre-sign modules, 3) use distro package (apt) that handles mok signing. Rolling back recommended until we have signed modules.

sahil: +1 rollback plan. Proposed actions:
- pause rollout in all regions
- mark nodes with kernel >=5.19 as impacted
- revert to driver 535 on impacted nodes via bootstrap image
- repro on metal with exact kernel combos
Need 8 spare nodes for canary, prefer same kernel variants.

sylvia: @sahil please coordinate with cloud team. Cost rough estimate for 8 nodes (p4d-ish) ~ $1.2k/week — finance ok?

linda: finance: we can approve short-lived canary spend, put under eng-infra budget code INF-DRIVER-2026

chris: also noticed NCCL warnings in dmesg on some nodes after partial load:
```
NCCL WARN Call to cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
nvidia: module ABI mismatch: kernel 6.1 vs module built for 5.15
```

matt: this smells like a mix of driver, CUDA toolkit and kernel headers mismatch. Which CUDA runtime do the containers expect? If driver is newer than CUDA major it usually works, but older drivers can fail.

ana: quick workaround for booting: boot into older kernel (5.15) via grub rescue on affected nodes, apt install linux-headers, dkms autoinstall, depmod -a, update-initramfs -u. Not great at scale.

sylvia: short-term plan agreed: pause rollout, rollback affected nodes to 535, repro on dedicated canary pool, sign modules for Secure Boot flows, and update bootstrap images with proper headers and signed modules. Long-term: add kernel-driver compatibility matrix to deploy pipeline.

ops-bot: 6 nodes marked UNHEALTHY in eu-west-staging (gpu count: 12 impacted). Canary stopped.

mike: let's add a preflight: check kernel version, headers existence, mokutil sb state, and dkms status. If any check fails -> abort rollout for that node.

sahil: I'll draft the preflight script and a one-time agent that can patch images. Will post PR later today.

sylvia: thanks. tagging oncall for visibility. We'll reconvene after canary repro.
